description: No restrictions have been established and enforced on the use of software to ensure compliance with contract agreements and copyright laws.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies operating cloud systems Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs) conducting assessments Federal information systems processing government data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review software asset management systems, license management databases, and acceptable use policies to verify controls on software usage. Look for absence of software whitelisting or blacklisting, missing license compliance tracking, unauthorized software installations, or lack of software usage policies. Check for systems lacking controls to prevent unlicensed software installation, missing software approval processes, or absence of periodic software audits to ensure license compliance and identify unauthorized applications.

sources.title: FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
